candidates.change_summary: Change the condition from 'msg.value > MinDeposit' to 'msg.value >= MinDeposit' so that deposits exactly equal to MinDeposit are also accepted.
Remove the require statement, allowing potential arithmetic overflow (though unlikely in practice) to silently wrap balances.
Replace the addition assignment with subtraction, so that the balance decreases on deposit.

Change the 'AddMessage' call to always record a zero value instead of msg.value, altering the log but not balances (no observable effect on balances). Skip: does not affect balances. Instead: change the require condition to use 'balances[msg.sender] + msg.value > balances[msg.sender]' which is always true, so removing the require has same effect. Actually, better: change the mapping key from msg.sender to address(0) so deposits are credited to address zero.
Replace the condition 'msg.value > MinDeposit' with 'msg.value < MinDeposit' so that only amounts strictly less than MinDeposit pass.
